mousenavigation.config.title: [MR] Mouse Navigation
mousenavigation.config.screen_back.toolt: Allows Mouse 4 to close screens or return to previous menus.
mousenavigation.config.screen_forward.to: Allows Mouse 5 to return forward into submenus you backed out of.
mousenavigation.config.books.tooltip: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to turn pages in written books and lecterns.
mousenavigation.config.recipe_book.toolt: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to flip recipe book pages.
mousenavigation.config.creative_tabs.too: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to cycle creative inventory item tabs.
mousenavigation.config.advancements.tool: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to cycle advancement tabs.
mousenavigation.config.chat_history.tool: Allows Mouse 4 / 5 to cycle previous / next sent chat messages.
mousenavigation.config.chat_middle_click: Allows middle mouse button (wheel click) to send messages in chat.
mousenavigation.config.sound.tooltip: Plays a soft click sound when performing a navigation action.
